title: Books and prophets matching
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Spring 1: The six pillars of iman
source: Written for islamic-studies/y2 lesson 2 (Pupil PDF worksheet: books and prophets matching)
intro: Lesson 2: Belief in the angels and the books. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

blocks.h: Match each book to its prophet

blocks.text: Draw a line from each book to the prophet it was given to.

blocks.answers: Tawrah (التَّوْرَاة): Musa; Zabur (الزَّبُور): Dawud; Injil (الإِنْجِيل): Isa; Qur'an (القُرْآن): Muhammad ﷺ

keywords.def: Allah's helpers made from light who always obey Him
the angel who brought Allah's message to the prophets
Allah's last book, sent to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ

questions.q: Finish: angels are made from ... and they always ... Allah.
Match each book to its prophet: Tawrah, Zabur, Injil, Qur'an.
questions.a: Tawrah: Musa; Zabur: Dawud; Injil: Isa; Qur'an: Muhammad ﷺ

questions.q: Extend: write one way we show respect to the Qur'an.
questions.a: For example: we keep it clean and high, we make wudu first.

questions.q: Stretch: why do we try to do good if angels write our deeds?
questions.a: So our record is full of good for the Last Day.

questions.q: Which book was sent to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ?
questions.a: A) The Qur'an. The Qur'an. The Zabur came to Dawud and the Tawrah to Musa.

questions.q: Think again: what good word will you add to your page today?
questions.a: For example: thank you, or a kind word to my sister.
